analysis.summary: California Software Company Limited issued its Annual Report for the Financial Year 2025-26 along with the notice for its 34th Annual General Meeting scheduled for September 29, 2026. The document details the ordinary and special business items, including the re-appointment of directors and independent directors such as Mr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah and Mr. Vijayakumar Madhavan. It also provides instructions for remote e-voting and attending the meeting via video conferencing.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that there is enormous latent demand in the small business segment for technology that is both powerful and practical.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth validated our thesis that there is enormous latent demand in the small business segment for technology that is both powerful and practical.

orders_capacity.claim: dSpeedUp's digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah is re-appointed as an Independent Director for a second term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31, 2026 up to July 30, 2031.
management_commitments.quote: re-appointed as an Independent Director of the Company for a second term, not liable to retire by rotation, for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31,2026 up to July 30,2031.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Vijayakumar Madhavan is re-appointed as a Non-Executive, Non Independent Director for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31, 2026 up to July 30, 2031.
management_commitments.quote: re-appointed as a Non-Executive, Non Independent Director, liable to retire by rotation, for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31,2026 up to July 30,2031.

management_commitments.claim: Calsoft remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs.
management_commitments.quote: As we look ahead, Calsofts remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs, ensuring that innovation is not just for the few, but for the many.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
